transcript.text: Could you clean up this old family scan in the attached photo? I've been meaning to give this family photo some attention for a while. What I need size-wise is for it to be enlarged to 640 pixels on the long side. I'm a little nervous about how it will turn out because it's a family picture. Please keep the sepia look and everyone's faces the same.

Your restored family photo is ready. It's 640 × 640 pixels, which is twice the size of the 320 × 320 scan, and still square like the original:

https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbgmiig013oir0150jh9mbk/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T014821Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-
(The link works for 24 hours, so please save the file.)

What I asked for: removing dust, specks and scratches, cutting down the grain, sharpening a little and evening out the fading. I also told it to keep the sepia tone, keep all four people's faces, expressions, clothes and poses the same, and keep the house and yard as they are, with no colorizing.

One thing to know: this was done with an AI image editor, which redraws the picture rather than just touching it up. I haven't been able to look at the result myself yet. At this small size it can sometimes slightly change a face, especially the little girl's and the people in the back. Please compare each face with the original before you keep it.

If any face looks wrong, tell me and I can try a gentler option: a plain 2× upscale (25 credits). That keeps faces almost exactly as they are, but it removes fewer scratches. This version used 5 credits.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a restored 640 × 640 image with a download link. It adds caveats about AI redrawing and possible face changes, and offers a gentler 2× upscale option. Per the definitions, a finished result with caveats is "delivered".
